title: NSIS: Fix our indentation.
description: The NSIS project uses 2-space indentation. Make sure we conform to that.

notes.body:
added 2 commits
  • 9e7a2b76 - NSIS: Fix our indentation.
  • 06f0b78c - NSIS: Deprecate 32-bit installs.
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/7069/diffs?diff_id=409181333&start_sha=5177230e27d218be735ebe2c5d78f3cd1be27f0b)
enabled an automatic merge when the pipeline for 06f0b78ce6412e58db0433c7f6438da2bf748035 succeeds

commits_data.message:
NSIS: Deprecate 32-bit installs.

Recommend 3.6 or earlier for 32-bit users.
